headline: The time goes on moving work between apps
copy: Most office work is the same information rewritten: the spreadsheet becomes the slide, the slide becomes the email, the meeting becomes a document nobody reads. AI is at its most useful exactly there — carrying one properly briefed piece of work from one app to the next instead of you rebuilding it each time.

echoCopy.inbox: You will learn how to get a long thread down to what was actually decided, what is still open, and what needs a reply from you — then draft that reply and read it before it goes anywhere.
echoCopy.retyping: You will learn how to brief AI once and carry that work through Word, Excel, PowerPoint and Outlook, so the report, the slide and the email all come from the same source instead of three retypings.
echoCopy.blank-page: You will learn how to turn rough notes into a working outline in Word or PowerPoint, so you start from a structure to improve rather than an empty page to fill.
echoCopy.data: You will learn how to ask a spreadsheet a plain-English question, then check the figure in the sheet itself before you repeat it to anybody.
echoCopy.meetings: You will learn how to prepare for a meeting, capture what was agreed, and turn it into named owners and real dates instead of a summary nobody acts on.
echoCopy.unknown: Most people have not seen AI reshape a document, explain a formula, draft a deck outline, condense an email thread and prepare a meeting brief. That is the whole course.

headline: You don't need a paid Copilot licence for this
copy: Microsoft sells Copilot as a paid add-on, and most people learning this do not have it. The course covers three setups — Copilot inside the apps, a separate chat AI alongside them, or a free tier only — and every lesson can be completed on the free path. You choose your setup in the second lesson.
